preferredPrimitives: Radix UI for focus-managed dialogs and tabs
Motion for rare state transitions and guided onboarding
native controls for forms and radio groups
patterns: Source Thread from campaign brief to source to result
vertical evidence log without fake percentage
editor layout with clip browser, viewer, timeline and inspector

must: Keep campaign intent, transcript words and visual proof visibly connected
Support default, loading, empty, error, success and 390px states
Use one ClipFactory blue for actions, source markers, focus and playheads; reserve green for verified success
Preserve source and brief context when billing blocks an analysis
avoid: generic metric-card dashboards before first value
purple-blue mesh heroes and glassmorphism on every surface
fake progress percentages, uploads, retries or subscription portal actions
transition-all, routine entrance animation and decorative infinite motion

decisions: Use Edit Axis as the canonical landing and one calm Apple Pro direction across the product
Use Signal Timeline as the canonical processing direction; keep Continuity and Manuscript only as temporary lab references
Use the account to guided brief to source to first-trial processing to locked teaser to contextual paywall to unlocked result to workspace sequence
Treat the contextual paywall as an interaction after first-clip playback, never as a separate numbered journey step
Keep the A-to-Z local journey as an interactive QA prototype; production requires a bounded first-job trial and gated outputs before moving the paywall after processing
Use Radix Dialog and Tabs rather than hand-rolling focus and keyboard behavior
Use three semantic campaign chapters rather than seven flat fields
Show billing checkout return as confirmation pending until subscription data is active
